subject.name: platform-practices
subject.scope: Official platform documentation for adaptation, audits and measurement.

findings.instagram: Use real profile material, original-content context and authorized Insights/Account Status.
findings.linkedin: Professional relevance matters; aggregate analytics do not identify every viewer.
findings.x: Views are not unique people; threads do not guarantee reach.
findings.youtube: Packaging and delivery should align; experiments may be inconclusive and retention needs real data.
findings.tiktok: Search suggestions guide research but do not prove factual claims; recommendation signals vary.

counterevidence: Public profiles do not reveal private retention or conversion
No fixed algorithm weights were established
Organic and paid distribution are different contexts
recommendations: Recheck mutable format limits at execution

coverage.access: Direct pages and indexed excerpts are distinguished in the source registry.

confidence.documentation: High for the narrow documented claims
confidence.account_availability: [uncertain] User-specific feature availability was not tested.
